Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, with a reported distal radius fracture of the wrist. The
mechanism of injury and the force described are consistent with the type of fracture reported. Treatment was provided over 18
visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this injury. Plain radiographs and follow-up imaging showed no
fracture displacement or residual abnormality, and objective findings on examination were not consistent with the degree of pain
and restricted movement the patient described. Staff also observed the paitent moving the wrist freely outside the examination
room. No prior injury to the same area is known from the history obtained. Billing records reviewed show no repeated or
duplicate charges for the same services. Ongoing care will focus on symptom review, range-of-motion monitoring, and a
return-to-activity plan based on objective findings.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
